comparison.objective: Permanently close a full sharps container before carrying it to a pickup bin; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Available evidence indicates lid latching followed by safe container transport versus coaxial mandrel alignment, hammer impacts, withdrawal, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Final lid snapped shut before transport to the bin versus four notch fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, no damage, and stable release.
comparison.reason: The indexed body omits latch-force, closure verification, transport, spill, and scoring details and provides no separate specs. Even so, permanent lid latching and container transport are meaningfully different from controlled tang fracture and recovery.
